about_the_game:
Dare to Escape the Prison—Together! 🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️ Think you can outsmart the guards and make your great escape? Team up with friends or compete against them in this heart-pounding multiplayer adventure! Navigate through trap-laden ventilation shafts, secret tunnels, and guarded hallways as you work together—or race to outdo each other. Gather coins along the way to unlock stylish outfits and boost your performance. Power-ups will be your savior when things get tough, so keep an eye out for them. Can you and your crew escape before it's too late?

Game Modes Designed for Multiplayer Fun

  • 👮 Prison Break: Join forces with friends and coordinate your escape plan, or compete to see who can break out first—bragging rights included!

  • 🔍 Glass Bridge: A test of trust and timing! Work with your team to pick the right glass panels, or leave them behind and race to the finish on your own.

  • 🌈 Obby Rainbow: A colorful and collaborative vertical journey—help your friends or make it a competition to see who climbs faster.

Features to Keep the Fun Going

  • 🎭 Choose from a lineup of quirky, unique characters and find the perfect fit for your prison break crew.

  • ⚡ Boost your gameplay with power-ups to outpace your friends and gain an edge.

  • 🎁 Claim exciting daily rewards to share the fun together.

  • 🎮 Dive into multiple game modes to keep the group engaged.

  • 🌍 Discover and explore new locations with your friends—each one more thrilling than the last.
